chars.OMAR: OMAR: a skinny 20-year-old young man wearing a red tracksuit jacket with black sleeves, black jogger pants, white sneakers and a small silver chain.
chars.GROOM: GROOM: a tall man around 30 wearing a beige blazer over a white shirt, dark navy trousers and brown loafers.
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a young woman wearing a lavender headscarf and a long cream dress with gold embroidery.
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: an older woman wearing a dark green caftan and a white headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the doorway of a modest Casablanca apartment, GROOM arrives smiling holding big wrapped gift boxes and a tray of sweets, MOTHER welcomes him happily with open arms.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room with sedari sofas, GROOM sits politely with hands on his knees, smiling shyly, while SISTER sits across from him looking happy and shy.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room, MOTHER and SISTER hug and laugh with joy, celebrating the engagement, mint tea glasses on a low table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room, GROOM visits again and pours mint tea from a silver teapot for MOTHER, both smiling warmly.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan apartment hallway, GROOM hands OMAR a new wrapped gift box; OMAR takes it with a sly smile, eyes looking sideways at the groom's expensive watch.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a busy Casablanca shopping street, GROOM carries many shopping bags and gift boxes for SISTER, who walks beside him delighted.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan bedroom, MOTHER and SISTER excitedly prepare for the wedding, holding up a shiny traditional caftan, open suitcases and boxes around them.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At night outside a huge luxurious white villa with glowing windows and a big iron gate in Casablanca, OMAR stands on the sidewalk with his back half turned, staring at the villa with narrowed suspicious eyes and a sneaky grin.
